sources.title: Colleen Hardwick For Mayor
sources.notes: Former councillor (2018-2022); B.A. UBC 1983, M.A. UBC 2011; founded New City Productions and PlaceSpeak; father Walter Hardwick councillor 1968-74.

sources.title: Raj Mundra For City Council
sources.notes: Civil engineer ~30 yrs in local building industry; boards incl. Society of Punjabi Engineers and Technologists of BC; Diabetes Canada volunteer; focus permit timelines.

sources.title: Josh Gordon For City Council
sources.notes: PhD (U of T), 7 yrs Asst Prof SFU School of Public Policy; Statistics Canada since 2021 (housing data, poverty measurement); treatment/prevention approach to addiction.

sources.title: Charles Kelly For City Council
sources.notes: Former federal public servant (housing policy); 30+ yrs management consulting; Commissioner General of UN World Urban Forum in Vancouver; ran Blarney Stone in Gastown 14 yrs.

sources.title: Amanda Boggan For City Council
sources.notes: DTES resident; former president of Downtown Eastside Neighbourhood Council; interest in rule of law, access to information, accountability.

sources.title: Patrick Sauriol For City Council
sources.notes: Digital entrepreneur (Coming Attractions website); 3 yrs Executive Director of DigiBC; instructor; wants economy diversified beyond tourism/real estate.

sources.title: Kathleen Larsen For City Council
sources.notes: 26 yrs municipal planning (community/heritage planner); Toronto Committee of Adjustment 2017-2020; appointed 2021 Director, Vancouver Heritage Foundation; TEAM Park Board candidate 2022.

sources.title: Jonathan Weisman For City Council
sources.notes: Lawyer; community centre board chair; Scout leader; pro bono clinic volunteer.

sources.title: Alex Tkach For Park Board
sources.notes: Digital effects/film post-production career (Emmy nomination 1982); defender of Langara Golf Course; parks as core services.

sources.title: Allan Fawley For Park Board
sources.notes: Vancouver educator 20 yrs; graduate degrees in urban planning and education.

sources.title: Jon Girard For Park Board
sources.notes: Software consultant; founding managing director of Protecting Our Vancouver Aquatic Centre Society (raised $110k+, judicial review vs City/Park Board).

sources.title: Mayeli Alvarez For Park Board
sources.notes: UBC Environmental Design; MSc Architectural Conservation (Edinburgh); director of Protecting Our Vancouver Aquatic Centre Society.

sources.title: Wah Gee For Park Board
sources.notes: Surrey elementary teacher and Indigenous Lead Teacher; serves on City of Vancouver Children, Youth and Families Advisory Committee; affordable recreation priority.

sources.title: Kat Nystedt For School Board
sources.notes: Parent of two at the Vancouver elementary she attended; restaurant server/supervisor in Kitsilano; UBCP member.
